## Kustomize Development

If you need to make a change within this folder, you would need to run two commands from within Codespaces:
1. `gh extension install github/gh-kustomize`
2. `gh kustomize build`

There are [docs](https://thehub.github.com/epd/engineering/products-and-services/internal/moda/kustomize/kustomize-at-github/) on the Hub related to Kustomize as well.
